plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Repo status band plus /ship: commit, push and deploy with a saved per-repo recipe

plugins.name: dev-servers
plugins.description: Pane of running dev servers with URLs, plus /up and /bounce from a saved per-project recipe

plugins.name: burn-meter
plugins.description: Turn time and cost in the status line, heartbeat toasts, a per-turn budget and a no-workflows switch

plugins.name: secret-catcher
plugins.description: Catches API keys pasted into prompts, saves them to an env file and sends a placeholder instead

plugins.name: traffic-control
plugins.description: Shows other live Claude sessions per repo and locks push/deploy so parallel sessions cannot collide

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: PR, CI and review threads for the checked-out branch: status line, /ci and /threads pane, finish toasts, and a threads tool for Claude

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Recalls lessons from the agent-kit brain into each prompt, lets Claude propose new ones for review, and shows the brain's health

plugins.name: recipe-run
plugins.description: Live recipe run pane: stage ladder, retries, router verdicts and spend, plus an inbox of blocking and non-blocking questions loops leave for a human

plugins.name: mods-panel
plugins.description: Mods panel: every agent-kit mod in one pane with live status and on/off switches, the recipe run and its questions, session spend and limits, plus a compact band above the prompt

plugins.name: build-log
plugins.description: Collects post material and screenshots as you work and drafts site, LinkedIn and X posts behind a private-denylist redaction check; never publishes
